objective: Define conservative feature-specific interpretation semantics for the 17,253 PIT-safe derived fundamental events before any deterioration/risk signal is built.

evidence_boundary.note: Distribution review is descriptive only; no market-outcome evidence has yet been used to validate whether any interpretation predicts returns.

REVENUE.allowed_interpretation: INCREASE => IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE; DECREASE => DETERIORATION_CANDIDATE; UNCHANGED => NEUTRAL
REVENUE.guard: If either value is non-positive or sign transition is not POSITIVE_TO_POSITIVE, require contextual review instead of directional interpretation.

PAT.allowed_interpretation: Numeric increase => IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE; numeric decrease => DETERIORATION_CANDIDATE; NEGATIVE_TO_POSITIVE and POSITIVE_TO_NEGATIVE are explicit strong sign-transition candidates.

PBT.allowed_interpretation: Numeric increase => IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE; numeric decrease => DETERIORATION_CANDIDATE; NEGATIVE_TO_POSITIVE and POSITIVE_TO_NEGATIVE are explicit strong sign-transition candidates.

EPS.allowed_interpretation: Numeric increase => IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE; numeric decrease => DETERIORATION_CANDIDATE; NEGATIVE_TO_POSITIVE and POSITIVE_TO_NEGATIVE are explicit strong sign-transition candidates.

OPERATING_CASH_FLOW.allowed_interpretation: Same-quarter YoY numeric increase => IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE; decrease => DETERIORATION_CANDIDATE; sign crossings are explicit strong candidates.

FINANCE_COST.allowed_interpretation: When both values are positive, INCREASE => DETERIORATION_CANDIDATE and DECREASE => IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE.
FINANCE_COST.guard: Any zero/negative value or sign transition requires contextual review because reversals/reclassifications can invalidate simple inverse semantics.

TAX.reason: Higher or lower tax can reflect profit level, effective tax rate, deferred tax, one-offs, or jurisdiction mix; direction alone is not a reliable deterioration semantic.

DEPRECIATION.reason: Higher or lower depreciation can reflect capital intensity, new assets, useful-life changes, or disposals; direction alone is not reliably good or bad.

CASH_AND_EQUIVALENTS.reason: Cash changes can reflect investment, distributions, financing, acquisitions, working capital, or operating stress; direction alone is not reliably good or bad.

TOTAL_ASSETS.reason: Asset growth or shrinkage can arise from expansion, divestment, impairment, acquisitions, or balance-sheet structure; direction alone is not reliably good or bad.

DEBT_EQUITY_RATIO.reason: No usable coverage in the frozen mapping.

non_signal_rules: IMPROVEMENT_CANDIDATE and DETERIORATION_CANDIDATE are semantic candidates only, not trading signals.
No feature weights, composite scores, thresholds, vetoes, rank changes, or portfolio actions are created in Phase 2A.6.
No market-return outcome is used in this run.
No model fitting, optimization, or production promotion.
